draft.subject: Shopney — Japan rollout for beauty retention apps
draft.body:
Hi Shopney team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company supporting commerce technology companies with Japan market development. We’re contacting Shopney about mobile app launch and push-retention campaigns for Japanese Shopify beauty brands building repeat-purchase channels.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean ecommerce teams, a managed mobile-app workflow could reduce repeated campaign setup while keeping localized offers active across product launches.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide app-launch design, retention workflows, and deployment priorities. Can we help plan and execute Shopney’s Japan rollout for these beauty brands?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
